articles.headline: Novartis's Christian Diehl on scaling AI beyond the demo
articles.summary: McKinsey interviews Christian Diehl, Novartis's chief AI officer, on the hard organizational and technical challenges of moving AI from proof-of-concept to production at scale within a large pharmaceutical company. Diehl addresses specific friction points including data governance, talent acquisition, and the complexity of aligning AI systems with regulatory workflows. The conversation offers a grounded, practitioner-level view of what enterprise AI deployment actually looks like in biopharma rather than aspirational framing.
articles.why_it_matters: For investors and strategists tracking AI's real competitive impact in pharma, this provides a rare inside view of where the moat actually forms — not in the demo, but in the data infrastructure and organizational capability to operationalize AI at scale, with direct relevance to NVS and how peers will be evaluated.
